text:
Rhea: Following up from the regional failover PM, consolidating action items so we don't scatter work across repos. Need owners + clear due dates.

Owen: TL;DR root causes we saw: stale RIB entries after cutover + intermittent snapshot manifest checksum failures during restore. Both caused partial traffic blackholing during rollover.

Zara: I'll own the RIB-staleness mitigation in the control plane (fast garbage-collect + explicit withdraw on cutover). ETA 2026-04-14.

Luis: I'll take the snapshot manifest verifier and add a pre-mark integrity step. Target 2026-04-03. Will include checksum + object-count check.

Tanya: Runbook gaps: we lacked a pre-cutover sampled-traffic validation and explicit rollback thresholds. I'll update the runbook and the game-day checklist. Due 2026-03-31.

Rhea: Good. Can we also add a lightweight mirroring step (5 mins) to validate steering immediately before cutover? That would've caught the asymmetry.

Owen: Agree. Mirror sampling sounds low-cost. I'll draft the mirroring config and add a devops playbook snippet. Due 2026-03-29.

deploy-bot: Staging window request: 3-hour slot created for 2026-03-30 08:00-11:00 UTC for routing + restore dry-run. Invites sent to @oncall, @Zara, @Luis, @Tanya.

infra-bot: Incident 2026-03-27-REGFAIL: status -> closed. Follow-ups created: 6. Link: https://incident-tracker/internal/2026-03-27-REGFAIL.

Rhea: Canonical AI list (will import into GH Projects + label "dr-followups"):

```
AI-401 | Control-plane RIB GC + withdraw on cutover  | owner: Zara  | due: 2026-04-14
AI-402 | Snapshot manifest integrity verifier       | owner: Luis  | due: 2026-04-03
AI-403 | Game-day pre-cutover mirroring (5m sample)  | owner: Owen  | due: 2026-03-29
AI-404 | Runbook: explicit rollback thresholds      | owner: Tanya | due: 2026-03-31
AI-405 | Staged routing + restore dry-run notes     | owner: Rhea  | due: 2026-03-30
AI-406 | Warm-standby cost sketch & ops checklist   | owner: Rhea  | due: 2026-04-06
```

Owen: I'll add a CI regression that simulates RIB churn and verifies path symmetry post-cutover. Tagging @Zara for review.

Zara: Ack. I'll include an automated assertion in infra-regressions that fails builds when asymmetry >10% in synthetic traffic.

Luis: Snapshot verifier will be a tiny service that runs pre-mark and on-demand before restores. I'll open a GH issue and PR this week.

Tanya: Rollback thresholds proposal: steering mismatch >20% for 2 consecutive 60s windows OR error-rate spike >3x baseline for 3 minutes. Will document steps to trigger immediate rollback and who to alert.

Rhea: For warm-standby cost sketch, finance check: ballpark monthly for snapshot storage + cross-region replication + minimal compute. @infra-bot can you create a finance ticket?

infra-bot: Finance estimate ticket created: CE-4900. Preliminary: ballpark ~$5k/mo. Final estimate due 2026-04-06.

Owen: Blocker note: soft-mirroring might not be supported on the current LB in A-region. If hardware tap required, we'll need a procurement window. I'll validate today.

Zara: If hardware needed, file a short escalation in #infra-procure; for now I'll prototype soft-mirror using span + sflow.

Luis: Small note on snapshot verifier: object-store eventual consistency means we'll add a small retry window before failing. Will include a tunable backoff param.

Rhea: Scheduling: we'll review AI status in the DR sync next Thu. If any AI slips, owner must post a one-line blocker update in this thread.

Tanya: Acknowledged.

Owen: PR for mirroring config draft pushed to repo infra/playbooks. Link: https://git.internal/infra/playbooks/pull/423 (WIP).

Luis: GH issue for snapshot verifier: https://git.internal/storage/issues/99. PR incoming.

Zara: Dev CI job created: infra-regressions/rib-churn-sim. Adding tests now.

Rhea: Thanks all. infra-bot: mark follow-ups tracked.

infra-bot: Follow-up checklist updated: 6 open AIs.

Rhea: Closing thread for now; reopen if blockers appear.
